name: canvas
description: CANVAS is a local multi-agent creative agency that runs entirely on your machine. It uses **n8n** as the workflow engine, **LM Studio** as the LLM runtime, and **TouchDesigner** as the visual output target. You give it a single creative brief, and a director model decomposes it into tasks, dispatches them to specialist agents, and delivers HTML essays, WebXR scenes, data visualisations, and TouchDesigner parameter networks — all while keeping a human in the loop for approval.
